what_to_detect: A card with mayhem in its owner's graveyard, discarded this turn, is a playable candidate (can_play true) for its mayhem cost.
near_miss: A mayhem card in the graveyard that was not discarded this turn, or whose play is otherwise illegal, is not playable (can_play false).
record_fields: decision candidate can_play, affordable, failed_checks zone (gen-3)

verdict_bit has no parameter restricting the candidate to one keyword's line or zone: with fires_when true and no restriction, any playable candidate in any decision record fires, so the detector would tag nearly every decision record.
